description: This file defines an interface IAVInput for interacting with AV input devices, including device configuration, notifications for device changes, signal changes, stream info updates, and various control methods related to HDMI/Composite inputs such as EDID management, input activation, and video settings within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IAVInput
classes.description: An interface for managing AV input devices, including configuration, notifications, and control operations for HDMI/Composite inputs.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the input device with the provided service shell.

methods.name: RegisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for device change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered device change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for signal change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered signal change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for input status change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered input status change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for video stream info update notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered video stream info update callback.

methods.name: RegisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for game feature status update notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered game feature status update callback.

methods.name: RegisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for AV content type update notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered AV content type update callback.

methods.name: NumberOfInputs
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available input ports.

methods.name: WriteEDID
methods.description: Changes the current EDID value for a specified port.

methods.name: ReadEDID
methods.description: Retrieves the current EDID value for a specified port.

methods.name: GetRawSPD
methods.description: Provides the raw SPD infoFrame packet for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: GetSPD
methods.description: Provides the SPD infoFrame packet info for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: SetEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the HDMI EDID version for a port.

methods.name: GetEdidVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: SetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Sets the ALLM support bit in EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Retrieves the ALLM support bit in EDID for a port.

methods.name: SetVRRSupport
methods.description: Sets the VRR support bit in EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetVRRSupport
methods.description: Retrieves the VRR support bit in EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetHdmiVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum HDMI compatibility version supported for a port.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Adjusts the audio mixer levels.

methods.name: StartInput
methods.description: Activates a specific HDMI/Composite input port.

methods.name: StopInput
methods.description: Deactivates the currently active input port.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video window position and size for an input.

methods.name: CurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current video mode of an input device.

methods.name: ContentProtected
methods.description: Checks if the content on an input port is protected.

methods.name: GetSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Returns the list of supported game features.

methods.name: GetGameFeatureStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a game feature like ALLM for a port.

methods.name: GetVRRFrameRate
methods.description: Obtains the current VRR frame rate for an input port.
